about: The Shop (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-07-equipment-shop-design.md). 'equipment' items change the simulation; their numbers are cited in docs/science/economy.md and phenology.md §6.

equipment.label: Frost candles
equipment.blurb: Paraffin candles set out between the rows, about 450 per hectare, and lit on a still, clear frost night.
equipment.what: lift the vine-level temperature by about 2 °C on clear, calm frost nights; useless in wind. About €4,500 per hectare per night.
equipment.when: frost warnings and the Programmes frost row.

equipment.label: Wind machine
equipment.blurb: A 10 m tower with a big fan that pulls the warmer air from above a frost inversion down into the vines. One covers about 5 ha.
equipment.what: on clear, calm frost nights it lifts the vines by about a third of the inversion (about 0.5–1.5 °C), for about €490 per hectare per night instead of candles; the crew still lights candles on the hardest nights. Useless in wind. Upkeep about €340 per hectare a year. It takes about three weeks to put up.
equipment.when: frost warnings and the Programmes frost row.

equipment.label: Overhead sprinklers
equipment.blurb: Sprinklers over the rows, run all night: as the water freezes on the shoots it releases heat and holds them near 0 °C.
equipment.what: hold the buds near 0 °C down to about −6 °C air, in clear and windy frosts alike, for about 10 nights a season before the reservoir runs dry (then candles). About €15,000 per hectare to install, €650 per hectare a year upkeep. About three weeks to install.
equipment.when: frost warnings and the Programmes frost row.

equipment.label: Vibrating sorting table
equipment.blurb: A vibrating table and conveyor where up to four people pick out rotten, raisined and damaged berries before the press.
equipment.what: makes Rigorous sorting possible at harvest: more of the rot removed, at the cost of more sound fruit and labour. Without it, sorting stays at Table level.
equipment.when: the harvest order's sorting choice on Plot & Blocks.
